To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

expansion ratio (rp/r0) is the most significant process parameter for peak load followed by the punch angle and tube temperatures and the expansion ratio (rpr/r0) is most important process parameter for energy absorption.
expansion ratio is the most important parameter that affects the peak load followed punch angle and tube temperate.
the peak load decreases with the increase of the expansion ratio and also the energy absorption increases with the increase of expansion ratio.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the expansion of aluminium tubes using die.
the effect of various process parameters on the expansion of thin-walled tubes.
the optimization of peak load and energy absorbed by the expanded tube using Taguchi method for different process parameters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the energy absorption increases as the expansion ratio increases, whereas it is decreased as the temperature increases and punch angle decreases.

the expansion ratio and punch angle are the most important process parameters that minimize the peak load followed the tube temperature and expansion ratio is the most important parameters that improves the energy absorption.
the energy absorption of expanded tubes is influenced by expansion ratios and punch angle.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expansion ratio is a very important process parameter that affects the response parameters.

, for the expansion of thin-walled aluminium tubes, it is recommended to use the medium punch angle (α= 30°) at higher temperature (T = 200°C) with the maximum expansion ratio (rp/r0 = 1.5) for the maximum energy absorption and minimum peak load.
the expansion ratio, punch angle and tube material temperature have significant effect on the peak load during the tube expansion process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the energy absorption and peak loads are affected by the expansion ratio and punch angle.
the expansion ratio is the most influential factor that minimizes the maximum load and improves the energy absorption.
the energy absorption and the peak load of the expansion tube can be controlled by varying the process parameters.
